name: SpiderWeb
summary: Australian ISP operating on spiderweb.com.au from Dec 1998 into the 2000s (also served from www2.spiderweb.com.au); ~1,000+ Wayback captures attest to an active, long-lived provider.

events.details: Earliest Wayback capture of spiderweb.com.au 12 Dec 1998; site active throughout the late 1990s-2000s. Earliest capture 12 dec 1998.

Death researched Aug 2026: spiderweb.com.au still serves as Spiderweb Cloud (WordPress/Email hosting) through at least 2020; APNIC block SPIDERWEBCLOUD-AU still announced via AS133159. May still be operating.
